summary: Fractal TUI: a harness prompt reads like its harness's own form, with its answers, on the Inbox card and expanded in place in its conversation; the band no longer sends you to Inbox to answer

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Client only. Uses the answers the daemon already lists under prompt.respond; nothing an answer means or how it reaches the harness changes. Adds a shared prompt form (fractal-views promptForm, fractal-ui-model prompts) for web, Fractal TUI and iOS.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
